_meta.source: Subset of assets/data/tbi/networks.json, network bmc-all-y5 (Mehta & Sudhakar 2025, BMC Neurology; recomputed from TBIMS public-use files, reproduces the published network). Only edges between the ten most prevalent post-injury conditions in Sudhakar et al. 2023 (Frontiers, Table 2) are kept. Aggregates only: phi coefficients, no counts.
_meta.edgeRule: phi from 2x2 tables of onset at/after injury, kept when the one-tailed t-test is significant at p < 0.01 (N-2 df)
